facts.fact: ACTPOL says Law No. 24.001 of 25 January 2024 gave the digital economy ministry 12 months to establish a supervisory agency, and in January 2026 it was unclear whether an authority had been appointed.
ACTPOL says the Authority is named in the 2024 law but its creation is left to a presidential decree, and it found none as of July 2026.

ACTPOL says the DRC's Digital Code (Ordinance-Law No. 23/010 of 13 March 2023) created a Data Protection Authority that has not been set up, and a ministerial order of August 2024 gave its functions to the telecommunications regulator meanwhile.
ACTPOL says Congo created its supervisory commission by Law No. 5-2025 of 29 March 2025 and found no evidence its members have been appointed.
